title: Have and Has, Parts of the Body

vocabulary.meaning_en: to own something; also to eat a meal
vocabulary.note_ar: مع I, you, we, they والجمع
vocabulary.note_en: With I, you, we, they and plural nouns.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the form of have for he, she, it and singular nouns
vocabulary.note_ar: مع he, she, it والاسم المفرد
vocabulary.note_en: With he, she, it and singular nouns.

vocabulary.meaning_en: all of a person or animal
the top part of your body, with your face and hair
the part of your face you see with
the part of your head you hear with
the part of your face you smell with
the part of your face you eat and speak with
vocabulary.note_ar: تنتهي بـ th، لا تخلطها مع mouse (فأر)
vocabulary.note_en: It ends in th; do not confuse it with mouse.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the soft part inside your mouth that tastes food
vocabulary.example: The dog has a pink tongue.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the part at the end of your arm with fingers
the long part of your body between your shoulder and hand
the part of your body you walk with
the part at the end of your leg that you stand on
the thin things that grow on your head
the part between your head and your body
vocabulary.example: A giraffe has a long neck.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the part a bird uses to fly
the hard mouth of a bird
vocabulary.example: The bird has a sharp beak.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the flat part a fish uses to swim
the long part at the back of an animal
vocabulary.example: The cat has a long tail.

vocabulary.meaning_en: with a thin edge or point that can cut
the first meal of the day
two pieces of bread with food between them
a desert animal with a hump
vocabulary.example: A camel has a long neck.

fine_lines.title: have vs has
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الاثنان بمعنى «عنده / يملك». have مع I و you و we و they وأي اسم جمع. has مع he و she و it وأي اسم مفرد.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both mean own or possess. Have goes with I, you, we, they and plural nouns. Has goes with he, she, it and singular nouns.

examples.sentence: A camel has a long neck.

fine_lines.title: is vs has
fine_lines.explanation_ar: is = يكون (لوصف الشيء: The elephant is big). has = عنده (لما يملكه: The elephant has big ears). لا نجمع بينهما: She is has ... خطأ.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Is describes what something is (The elephant is big). Has tells what it owns (The elephant has big ears). Never use both together: "She is has" is wrong.

fine_lines.title: mouth vs mouse
fine_lines.explanation_ar: mouth (فم) تنتهي بصوت th. mouse (فأر) تنتهي بصوت s.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Mouth ends with a th sound. Mouse ends with an s sound.

examples.sentence: Close your mouth when you eat.
The mouse is under the table.

expressions.example: I have two eyes, two ears and one nose.

expressions.meaning_en: Parents are plural, so we use have.
expressions.example: My parents have a small white car.

grammar.title: Have / has: meaning
grammar.explanation_ar: have فعل بمعنى يملك أو عنده، ويأتي أيضًا بمعنى يتناول (have breakfast). هو فعل بنفسه، لذلك لا نضع قبله am/is/are: I am have ✗ → I have ✓.
grammar.explanation_en: Have is a verb meaning own or possess. It can also mean eat (have breakfast). It is already a verb, so we do not add am/is/are: I am have ✗ → I have ✓.
examples: She is has long hair. ✗ → She has long hair. ✓

grammar.title: Have with I, you, we, they and plurals
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم have مع I و you و we و they ومع أي اسم جمع (مثل the cats, my parents).
grammar.explanation_en: Use have with I, you, we, they and plural nouns (the cats, my parents).

grammar.title: Has with he, she, it and singular nouns
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم has مع he و she و it ومع أي اسم مفرد (Heba, the cat). لاحظ: الكلمات التي تأخذ is مع be هي نفسها التي تأخذ has (لاحظ حرف s في الاثنين).
grammar.explanation_en: Use has with he, she, it and singular nouns (Heba, the cat). The words that take is also take has (both end in s).
examples: The cat has a long tail.

grammar.title: Be or have?
grammar.explanation_ar: استخدم am/is/are عندما تصف الشيء أو تقول ما هو (يكون). واستخدم have/has عندما تتكلم عما يملكه (عنده).
grammar.explanation_en: Use am/is/are to say what something is or describe it. Use have/has to say what it owns.
examples: The elephant is big. It has big ears.
Elephants are big. They have big ears.
I am happy. I have a new bike.

questions.question: Camels ___ four legs.
questions.explanation_en: Camels is plural, so it takes have.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
questions.explanation_ar: لا نجمع بين is و has، و she تأخذ has.
questions.explanation_en: Do not use is and has together; she takes has.

questions.question: The elephant ___ big.
questions.explanation_ar: نصف الفيل بأنه كبير، فنستخدم is (يكون).
questions.explanation_en: We describe the elephant, so we use is.

questions.question: What is "لسان" in English?
questions.explanation_en: Your tongue is inside your mouth.

questions.question: A bird uses its ___ to fly.
questions.explanation_en: A bird flies with its wings.

questions.question: What is the plural of "foot"?
questions.explanation_en: Foot has an irregular plural: feet.

questions.question: "I have breakfast at seven." Here "have" means ...
My parents ___ a small car.
questions.explanation_en: My parents is plural, so it takes have.
